title: Pi sandbox extension configuration
description: Configuration for packages/sandbox. This describes the JSON settings the extension actually merges and passes to @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime 0.0.71.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI used by editors. Ignored by the extension.

ignoreViolations.description: Map command substrings to violation-text substrings that should be suppressed from runtime reports. The special command key '*' applies to every command. This does not change policy enforcement.

enableWeakerNestedSandbox.description: Linux: enable weaker isolation for nested environments such as unprivileged containers.

domainPortPattern.description: Exact domain, leading-wildcard subdomain, localhost, or bracketed IPv6 literal, optionally followed by a port from 1 through 65535. Bare '*' and overly broad wildcards such as '*.com' are not allowed.

anyOf.description: Deny all domains, optionally on one destination port.

hostDomainPattern.description: Host-only domain pattern without a port suffix. IPv6 literals are unbracketed in these host-only fields.

path.description: Filesystem path. Relative paths resolve against the process working directory; '~' expands to the host user's home directory.

allowedDomains.description: Allowed outbound domains. An empty array denies every unmatched host because this extension installs no permission callback.

deniedDomains.description: Explicitly denied outbound domains. Deny rules take precedence over allow rules.

deniedDomainReasons.description: Model-facing reasons keyed by exact deniedDomains entries.

strictAllowlist.description: Deny unmatched hosts without consulting a permission callback. This extension supplies no callback, so unmatched hosts are denied regardless.

allowUnixSockets.description: macOS only: Unix socket paths to allow. Ignored on Linux.

allowAllUnixSockets.description: Allow all Unix sockets and disable Unix-socket blocking on both supported platforms.

allowLocalBinding.description: Allow sandboxed processes to bind local listening ports.

items.description: macOS XPC/Mach service name. A wildcard is allowed only as one trailing '*'.

allowMachLookup.description: macOS only: additional XPC/Mach services to allow.

httpProxyPort.description: Local external HTTP proxy port. The external proxy must enforce domain policy.

socksProxyPort.description: Local external SOCKS proxy port. The external proxy must enforce domain policy.

socketPath.description: Unix socket path of the upstream MITM proxy.

domains.description: Host-only domain patterns routed through the MITM proxy.

caCertPath.description: PEM CA certificate used to sign per-host certificates.

caKeyPath.description: PEM private key corresponding to caCertPath.

excludeDomains.description: Host-only patterns whose HTTPS traffic remains an opaque tunnel.

extraCaCertPaths.description: Additional PEM CA files appended to the child trust bundle.

tlsTerminate.description: Experimental in-process HTTPS termination. Omit both CA paths to use a generated CA.

http.description: Parent proxy URL for plain HTTP traffic.

https.description: Parent proxy URL for HTTPS/CONNECT traffic; falls back to http when unset.

noProxy.description: Comma-separated hostname-suffix and CIDR bypass list.

disabled.description: Disable all filesystem restrictions, including mandatory protections. Network restrictions remain active.

allowRead.description: Paths re-allowed for reading inside denied regions. Takes precedence over denyRead.

allowWrite.description: Paths allowed for writing. All other paths are read-only.

denyWrite.description: Paths denied for writing inside allowed write paths. Takes precedence over allowWrite. Linux supports literal paths only.

allowGitConfig.description: Allow writes to repository .git/config files while keeping .git/hooks protected. Does not control reads or the working-directory .gitconfig mandatory protection.
